---
title: "License"
---

ADCP is distributed under the [Sannerlab MIT-like Source-Available License](/software/license.qmd), the license of all the lab's software. If you publish work
that uses ADCP, the license asks you to cite the [ADCP papers](index.qmd#how-to-cite).

ADFRsuite 1.0, which includes ADCP 1.0, also contains the **MSMS** program and the **MSLIB**
component, which compute molecular surfaces. For them the license covers non-commercial use only;
commercial use needs a separate license. Of the suite's programs, only `agfrgui` uses them, for
surface calculation and display. They are not used by `adfr`, `agfr`, `autosite`, `adcp`,
`prepare_ligand` or `prepare_receptor`.

For a commercial license for MSMS and MSLIB, contact [Dr. Michel Sanner](mailto:sanner@scripps.edu).
